_doc: Hand-curated items and consumables — distinct from weapons. Pop Greens, drugs, foods, dials, currencies, etc.

items.name: Energy Steroids
items.notes: Boost a fishman's natural strength to dangerous levels — every dose ages the user one year. Hody overdosed and prematurely aged.

items.name: SMILE Fruits
items.notes: Artificial Devil Fruits made by Caesar Clown from SAD. Failure rate is high — failed users laugh uncontrollably forever.

items.name: Failed SMILEs (Smile)
items.notes: Stolen by the Beasts and given to Wano civilians — they cannot stop smiling, even at funerals.

items.name: Rumble Ball
items.notes: Chopper's invention. Disrupts his Devil Fruit's wavelength to unlock additional Points. Overdosing causes Monster Point.

items.name: Pop Greens
items.notes: Boin Archipelago plants — sprout instantly on impact into vines, mushrooms, traps. Usopp's post-timeskip arsenal.

items.name: Cola (Franky's fuel)
items.notes: Franky's bio-cybernetic body runs on cola. Empty tank = empty Franky.

items.name: Tone Dial
items.notes: Sky-island shells that record and play back sound. Used by Roger to leave a message at Laugh Tale.

rungs.notes: Sky-island shells that record and play back sound.
Sky-island shells that record and play back sound. Used by Roger to leave a message at Laugh Tale.

items.name: Impact Dial
items.notes: Stores impacts and releases them. Usopp received one from Conis.

items.name: Flame Dial
items.notes: Belches flame on use.

items.name: Vivre Card
items.notes: Paper imbued with a person's life-force. Burns away as their life fades — points to the carrier's location.

items.name: Eternal Pose
users: Strawhats and other Grand Line crews
items.notes: Permanently locked Log Pose, points to one specific island. Cannot be re-locked.

items.name: Log Pose
items.notes: Magnetic compass that locks onto an island. Required to navigate the Grand Line.

items.name: Bubble Coral
items.notes: Sap from Yarukiman Mangroves. Used to coat ships for underwater travel.

items.name: Mother Flame
items.notes: Vegapunk's solar-flame weapon. Shown when the Five Elders Buster-Called Lulusia. Mass-destruction tier.

items.name: ENIES Lobby Gates
items.notes: Gate of Justice — controls the Tarai Current to Impel Down and Marineford.

items.name: Sea Prism Stone
items.notes: Ocean-mineral that nullifies Devil Fruits on contact. Made into cuffs, weapons, ship plating. (Detailed in Materials.)

items.name: Beli (the Berry)
items.notes: Standard currency. Wanted-poster bounties are denominated in Beli.

items.name: King's Plate
items.notes: Vegapunk's seastone-substitute experimental material — referenced during the Egghead arc.

items.name: Mochi (Whole Cake)
items.notes: Mochi-Mochi no Mi byproduct — Katakuri stuffs himself with mochi to hide his shark teeth.

items.name: Whole Cake (the cake)
items.notes: The eponymous wedding-cake mountain — Big Mom's craving central. Triggers a craving-fit when she can't have one.

items.name: Bink's Sake
items.notes: Iconic pirate shanty. Brook's signature song. Performed at Thriller Bark, Whole Cake, and many other moments.
